entries.zh: 会合、相聚；引申为聚议商定、彼此达成一致。
entries.en: to come together, to assemble; to agree, to come to an accord.
entries.notes: H 首字[疑:找/抓]与 M 音 gîy 不合，疑为「議」(gī)；释义依 L「juntarse, concertarse」。

entries.zh: 扫集垃圾秽物，归拢成堆。
entries.en: to gather up the rubbish and heap it together.
entries.notes: H 第三字[疑:叫/叩]未定，M 作 quiò，疑为表「拾取归拢」之方言字；释义依 L「juntar la basura, amontonarla」。

entries.zh: 接合、拼合；使两相凑合妥帖。
entries.en: to join together; to fit or adjust one thing to another.
entries.notes: H 第二字[疑:扣/描]未定，M 作 câ；释义依 L「ajustar」。

entries.zh: 相与并立、同居共处（彼此协调一致）。
entries.en: to be joined together in concert; to stand together in harmony or agreement.
entries.notes: H 首字[疑:兩/西]，M 第二音标记 T99 污损难辨；释义依 L「juntarse en concierto」。

entries.zh: 彼此相同、共同一致；相互共处、通力合作。
entries.en: to be together and of one accord; to share or act in common with one another.

entries.zh: 集合兵众、动员士卒（调集兵民）。
entries.en: to muster soldiers and men; to mobilize troops.
entries.notes: L 作「juntar」，H 取「動兵」(tāng-peng) 动员兵众，义近而语用有别。

entries.zh: 头尾相接、首尾相连（使从头到尾连成一体）。
entries.en: to join tail to head, i.e. to connect end to end.
entries.notes: 「甲」为「佮」(kah，与、同) 的同音借字，頭佮尾即首尾相接。

entries.en: to amass wealth, to gather riches.

entries.zh: 恶行越积越多，愈益凶恶（越来越坏）。
entries.en: to heap up more and more wickedness; to grow worse and worse.
entries.notes: 「那…那…」为 ná…ná… 递进式；「却」疑借作 khiap（恶、劣），全句依 L「ser mas y mas malo」定。

entries.zh: 积少成多（把少量逐渐累积成众多）。
entries.en: to accumulate little by little until it becomes much; many a little makes a mickle.
to accumulate and lay up, to store up.

entries.zh: 囤积粮草（储积军需粮秣）。
entries.en: to store up grain and fodder (military provisions).
entries.notes: L 末词截断作 soldadτ，义据 H「積糧草」与 M 音定。

entries.zh: 相合、彼此投合；合为一体。
entries.en: to come together, to match or agree; to join as one.

entries.zh: 合掌（双掌相合，用以行礼或祈祷）。
entries.en: to join the palms together (in greeting or prayer).
